accueil.meta_titre: Green Biometry: reliable, shared environmental data
accueil.meta_description: A catalogue of reviewed environmental data, maps and indicators, with source, method and limits always visible. Pilot in Benin.
accueil.hero_titre: Environmental data you can trust, documented and shared
accueil.hero_texte: Find, compare and cite reviewed datasets. Track indicators and restoration projects, with source, method and limits always in view.
accueil.circuit_titre: No data is published without review
accueil.circuit_texte: Every contribution follows the same path. Its status is visible at each step, to the contributor and to the public.
accueil.etape1_texte: The contributor uploads a file with the required metadata and declares their rights.
accueil.etape2_texte: Source, licence and permission to share are verified.
accueil.etape3_texte: Format, units, coordinates and duplicates are tested automatically.
accueil.etape4_texte: A scientific reviewer examines the method, consistency and limits.
accueil.etape5_texte: The data is published according to its access level, with its licence and citation.
accueil.theme_forets_texte: Forest cover, loss and gain, biomass.
accueil.theme_restauration_texte: Tree planting, seedling survival, restoration projects.
accueil.theme_sols_texte: Land cover maps and land-use change.
accueil.indic_texte: Every indicator shows its unit, period, method and validation level. Observed, estimated, target and reported values are never mixed up.
accueil.principes_titre: What you can expect from every dataset
accueil.p1_texte: Source, date, author and method are documented. Every version keeps its fingerprint.
accueil.p2_texte: Validation status, uncertainties and limits are shown next to the data.
accueil.p3_texte: The source licence and attribution are kept. Sensitive data is not published by default.
accueil.cta_texte: NGOs, laboratories, universities, institutions: share your datasets within clear rules. You keep ownership; the platform documents, reviews and makes them visible.
accueil.credit_hero: Photo: Pendjari National Park from the air, Marie-Michaire LIMA, CC BY-SA 4.0

catalogue.meta_description: Documented and reviewed environmental datasets: forests, restoration, land cover, water, climate. Pilot in Benin.
catalogue.intro: Every record states the source, method, licence and limits of the dataset. Only datasets published after review appear here.
catalogue.vide_texte: Try another keyword, widen the period or remove a filter.
catalogue.note_restreint: Restricted or private datasets are only visible to authorised people.

fiche.telechargement_note: By downloading, you accept the {licence} licence. Cite the source whenever you reuse it.
fiche.telechargement_refuse_texte: The source licence does not allow the files to be redistributed. Contact the producer to access them.
fiche.telechargement_demo: Demo: no file is actually downloaded.
fiche.versions_intro: Every version keeps its file and fingerprint: a previous version remains available.
fiche.validation_intro: The review steps this dataset passed before publication.
fiche.reserve_texte: Administrative and technical checks are complete, but the scientific review is not finished. Use this dataset with care.
fiche.apercu_alerte_texte: These periods are not shown. Do not read the gap as a trend.

carte.meta_description: Map of the areas covered by Green Biometry's environmental datasets: forests, restoration, land cover, water, climate.
carte.intro: Each frame shows the area covered by a dataset. Click the map to see the datasets available at a point, or pick a dataset from the list.
carte.region_label: Interactive map of the areas covered by the datasets
carte.sans_js: The map needs JavaScript. The dataset list next to it still works.
carte.note_emprise: Frames are extents: the rectangle enclosing the study area, not its exact outline. The datasets shown are demonstration examples.
carte.popup_aucun: No dataset shown covers this point.

indicateurs.meta_description: Documented environmental indicators: definition, unit, method, source and change over time. Pilot in Benin.
indicateurs.intro: Each indicator sums up a dataset as one figure tracked over time. Its page gives the definition, calculation method, source and interpretation limits.
indicateurs.une_valeur: Not enough measurements yet to show a change.
indicateurs.note_titre: What may change, what may not
indicateurs.note_texte: How an indicator is displayed may change, but not what it means. Any change to a definition, unit or method is dated and approved by its scientific lead.

indicateur.manque_texte: These years are left empty: the line is not drawn between the values around them.
indicateur.source_intro: The indicator is calculated from this dataset:
indicateur.voir_zone: Show the area on the map

projets.meta_description: Restoration and conservation projects tracked on Green Biometry: indicators, baselines, targets and progress reports.
projets.intro: Each project tracks at least two indicators, with a baseline, a target and the history of measurements. Missing reports stay visible.
projets.limite_titre: What these figures say, and what they do not
projets.limite_texte: The platform shows the results reported by projects. It never automatically attributes an ecological change to an intervention: that requires a protocol, a baseline, long-term monitoring and, if possible, a comparison with an area without intervention.

projet.suivi_intro: For each indicator: the starting point, the latest value and the target. The nature of each value is shown.
projet.type_observee_aide: measured in the field or on imagery, documented protocol
projet.type_estimation_aide: calculated from a sample or a model
projet.type_declaree_aide: reported by the project holder, not yet checked
projet.manque_texte: These periods stay empty in the charts: no value is made up to fill them.
projet.activites_intro: What the project did. These are activities, not effects on the environment.
projet.rapports_intro: One report per period. A submitted report awaits validation; a validated report has been checked.

apropos.meta_description: Green Biometry: a platform to make environmental data accessible, understood and useful for action. Mission, principles and progress.
apropos.intro: Green Biometry aims to make environmental data more accessible, understandable, comparable and useful for action, research and decision-making.
apropos.mission_titre: Reliable data, to act for living systems
apropos.mission_texte: Collect, organise, document, analyse and share reliable environmental information, while making it easier to track conservation, sustainable management and ecosystem restoration initiatives.
apropos.vision_texte: The pilot starts in Benin and West Africa. The ambition is to become a reference space, beyond the region, for everyone who produces or uses this data.
apropos.photo_alt: Africa seen from space: the Sahara in ochre, Central Africa's forests in dark green, the ocean all around.
apropos.photo_credit: Africa seen by the Suomi NPP satellite. NASA/NOAA, public domain, via
apropos.constat_titre: The data exists, but is too rarely used
apropos.constat1_texte: Inventories, field measurements, satellite images, GPS surveys, reports: information is spread across institutions, NGOs and laboratories, in formats that do not talk to each other.
apropos.constat2_texte: Without a source, method, licence or date, a file is hard to reuse and impossible to cite. Its limits stay invisible.
apropos.constat3_texte: Going from a raw file to a map or an indicator takes time and skills. Project monitoring often stops at counting activities.
apropos.plateforme_intro: Every piece of published information shows its validation status, source and licence.
apropos.brique_carte: The areas covered by each dataset, on a single map.
apropos.brique_indicateurs: Figures tracked over time, with their definition and limits.
apropos.brique_projets: Project monitoring: baseline, target and measured results.
apropos.brique_contribuer: Submit your data, have it reviewed by an evaluator, then publish it.
apropos.principes_titre: What we will not compromise on
apropos.p1_texte: Every piece of published information has a documented source, date, contributor and method.
apropos.p2_texte: Validation status, limits and uncertainties are always visible. Missing data is shown, never filled in.
apropos.p3_texte: Explicit methods and units, comparisons put in context. No ecological change is automatically attributed to a project.
apropos.p4_texte: Findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable. Open formats and standards come first.
apropos.p5_texte: For data from communities, the CARE principles: collective benefit, authority to control, responsibility, ethics.
apropos.p6_texte: A light website that works on a phone and with a weak connection, in French and English.
apropos.etat_titre: What exists, and what is planned
apropos.etat_intro: This website is a design prototype: it shows the interface, but it is not yet an operational service. Content marked DEMO is fictitious.
